title: 介绍一个环境微生物项目
description: 原创科研表达练习。讲述自己的项目时请替换为真实经历和结果。

source.title: 科研小盒原创表达练习

sentences.en: Our study examines how environmental change shapes soil microbial communities.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究探讨环境变化如何塑造土壤微生物群落。
sentences.note: 用 examines how 引出具体研究问题。把 environmental change 替换为你的真实研究因素。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: We compared microbial communities across sites with different soil properties.
sentences.zh: 我们比较了具有不同土壤性质的地点之间的微生物群落。
sentences.note: across sites 表达跨地点比较；with different soil properties 修饰 sites。这里只是表达模板，请按实际设计修改。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: An association between two taxa does not establish a direct interaction.
sentences.zh: 两个分类单元之间存在关联，并不能确立它们存在直接互作。
sentences.note: between two taxa 修饰 association；establish 表示确立证据，比 suggest 更强。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: This result suggests a possible link that requires further investigation.
sentences.zh: 这一结果提示了一种需要进一步研究的可能联系。
sentences.note: suggests a possible link 表达候选解释；that 引导定语从句，修饰 link。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: One limitation is that the available samples cover a narrow range of conditions.
sentences.zh: 一个局限是现有样本仅覆盖较窄的条件范围。
sentences.note: One limitation is that… 先点明一个具体局限，再说明它影响哪一类推断。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: The next step is to connect the computational findings with a testable biological question.
sentences.zh: 下一步是将计算分析发现与一个可检验的生物学问题联系起来。
sentences.note: connect A with B 强调两者之间的联系。testable 指问题可以通过证据加以检验。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

chunks.zh: 与可检验的生物学问题

title: 把分析选择讲清楚
description: 原创科研表达练习。讲述自己的项目时请替换为真实经历和结果。

source.title: 科研小盒原创表达练习

sentences.en: Before interpreting the results, we checked the sample metadata.
sentences.zh: 在解释结果之前，我们检查了样本元数据。
sentences.note: Before + 动名词短语可交代分析顺序。metadata 是集合概念，通常不使用 metadatas。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: We adjusted for measured covariates to reduce potential confounding.
sentences.zh: 我们对测得的协变量进行了调整，以减少潜在混杂。
sentences.note: adjust for 是固定搭配；to reduce 表示目的，不能单凭调整就声称排除了所有混杂。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: The background set should reflect the genes eligible for selection.
sentences.zh: 背景集合应反映有资格被选入分析的基因。
sentences.note: eligible for + 名词表示有资格参与某事。说明你的基因筛选范围，有助于解释富集分析。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: My contribution was to make the analysis workflow easier to reproduce.
sentences.zh: 我的贡献是让分析流程更容易复现。
sentences.note: My contribution was to… 后接具体行动。使用前确认这确实是你的个人贡献。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: I would test whether the finding holds in an independent dataset.
sentences.zh: 我会检验这一发现能否在独立数据集中成立。
sentences.note: would test 明确这是拟议行动；holds 表示结论依然成立。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

sentences.en: Could you clarify which part of the analysis you would like me to explain?
sentences.zh: 您能说明希望我解释分析中的哪一部分吗？
sentences.note: Could you clarify… 是礼貌的澄清请求，有助于在面试中避免答非所问。
sentences.question: How would you explain this idea using your own research?

title: 读论文：问题、证据与解释
description: 原创科研表达练习。讲述自己的项目时请替换为真实经历和结果。

source.title: 科研小盒原创表达练习

sentences.en: What question does this study address?
sentences.zh: 这项研究回答了什么问题？
sentences.note: 这是特殊疑问句。What question 是 address 的宾语，前置后用 does + 主语 + 动词原形；address a question 表示探讨一个问题。
sentences.question: What makes this question important?

chunks.zh: 构成一般现在时疑问句

sentences.en: The authors used an independent dataset to evaluate the model.
sentences.zh: 作者使用独立数据集评估模型。
sentences.note: 主干为 The authors used an independent dataset；to evaluate the model 是目的状语，说明使用数据集的用途。
sentences.question: Why is an independent dataset useful?

sentences.en: The reported effect was smaller after adjustment.
sentences.zh: 校正后报告的效应较小。
sentences.note: 主干是主语 + 系动词 + 比较级表语。after adjustment 说明调整后的状态；比较对象需由上下文交代。这里是表达示例，具体效应大小应以论文结果为准。
sentences.question: Which variables were included in the adjustment?

sentences.en: The abstract does not provide enough detail to assess this claim.
sentences.zh: 摘要没有提供足够细节来评估这一论断。
sentences.note: does not provide 构成否定谓语。enough detail to assess this claim 表示足以评估这一主张的细节；不定式说明所需细节的用途。
sentences.question: Where would you look for more detail?

sentences.en: I would check the methods before interpreting the figure.
sentences.zh: 在解读这张图之前，我会先查阅方法。
sentences.note: would check 表达拟议行动；before interpreting the figure 是时间状语，before 后接动名词短语。
sentences.question: What information do you need to interpret the figure?

sentences.en: The main conclusion should be considered in the context of the study design.
sentences.zh: 主要结论应结合研究设计来理解。
sentences.note: should be considered 是情态动词 + 被动结构。in the context of the study design 提供理解结论时所依据的背景。
sentences.question: How does the design affect the interpretation?

title: 实验室面试与学术交流
description: 原创科研表达练习。讲述自己的项目时请替换为真实经历和结果。

source.title: 科研小盒原创表达练习

sentences.en: My research focuses on computational approaches to biological questions.
sentences.zh: 我的研究聚焦于用计算方法回答生物学问题。
sentences.note: 主干为 My research focuses on computational approaches；to biological questions 修饰 approaches。focus on 表示聚焦于，approaches to 表示针对某问题的方法。
sentences.question: Can you give one concrete example?

chunks.zh: 用于解决生物学问题的

sentences.en: I am particularly interested in how your group integrates different types of data.
sentences.zh: 我尤其感兴趣的是你们团队如何整合不同类型的数据。
sentences.note: 主干为 I am interested in…，particularly 修饰 interested。how 引导介词 in 的宾语从句；从句使用 your group integrates… 的陈述语序。
sentences.question: How would your skills contribute to this work?

sentences.en: I can explain the overall idea first and then discuss the technical details.
sentences.zh: 我可以先解释总体思路，再讨论技术细节。
sentences.note: can explain 与 discuss 是并列谓语，共用主语 I 和情态动词 can。first 与 then 标示讲述顺序，两个动词后分别接自己的宾语。
sentences.question: Explain the idea to someone outside your field.

sentences.en: Could you give me a moment to organize my thoughts?
sentences.zh: 可以给我一点时间整理思路吗？
sentences.note: Could you… 用于礼貌请求。give me a moment 是 give + 间接宾语 + 直接宾语；to organize my thoughts 说明这段时间用于整理思路。
sentences.question: Summarize your answer in two sentences.

sentences.en: What would success look like during the first six months?
sentences.zh: 前六个月做到什么程度算是成功？
sentences.note: What 是介词 like 的宾语，疑问句中前置；主干为 success would look like what。during 引出时间范围，整句用于询问具体的成功标准。
sentences.question: What would be a realistic first milestone?

sentences.en: Thank you for the discussion; it helped me understand the project more clearly.
sentences.zh: 谢谢这次讨论，它帮助我更清楚地理解这个项目。
sentences.note: 分号连接两部分。Thank you 是常用感谢表达；it 指前面的 discussion。helped me understand 使用 help + 宾语 + 不带 to 的不定式，more clearly 修饰 understand。
sentences.question: What did you learn from the conversation?
